title: Seven Blood-Stained Orchids
writer: Roberto Gianviti, Paul Hengge, Umberto Lenzi
actors: Antonio Sabato, Uschi Glas, Pier Paolo Capponi
plot: A fashion designer's wife is targeted by a mysterious assailant, along with six other women who used to work for her when she owned a hotel resort, over something that supposedly happened two years ago.
